items.summary: Implement backend query APIs required for Admin Panel data loading: (1) list questions filtered by subject for the Question Gallery, and (2) ensure suggestions listing continues to work with the existing listSuggestions() response shape used by the frontend.

Wire the Question Management UI to real backend data by updating the React Query hook useGetQuestionsBySubject(subject) to call the new backend query API and return the fetched list instead of an empty array stub.

Ensure Suggestions Moderation loads and updates correctly end-to-end: the useGetAllSuggestions hook fetches from backend listSuggestions(), and after deleting a suggestion via useDeleteSuggestion(), the suggestions list refreshes (query invalidation) and the UI reflects the deletion.
